overview: A polished pseudo-3D isometric action-puzzle game where a cute big-nosed creature hops diagonally across a pyramid of cubes, turning every top face to the target color while dodging enemies and riding escape discs.
features: Hop diagonally across a 3D pyramid of cubes to change their color
Classic color rules: one hop, two hops, and flip-back stages
Roster of enemies including egg-hatching snakes, side-crawlers, and falling balls
Floating discs that ride you back to the apex and can lure the snake off
Arcade scoring, extra lives, and escalating stages
Pseudo-3D isometric view with a free-orbit camera option
